sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Policy Schedule)

room_rent.display: Not specified (base); 1% of SI/day up to ₹5,000 optional
room_rent.note: Base policy wording does not cap room rent; Room Rent Modification Option (optional add-on, Section B-III-13) introduces 1% of Basic SI/day up to ₹5,000. Base inbuilt value is unclear/no cap stated.

icu.display: Not specified (base); 2% of SI/day up to ₹10,000 optional
icu.note: Base policy does not cap ICU; Room Rent Modification Option (optional, Section B-III-13) introduces 2% of Basic SI/day up to ₹10,000.

copayment.display: None (Tier 1 premium); 20% if Tier 2 insured treats in Tier 1 city
copayment.note: No co-pay for Tier 1 premium payers. 20% co-pay applies if Tier 2 premium payer avails treatment in Tier 1 cities. Optional Co-Payment add-on (Section B-III-14) can add further co-pay. Co-pay waived for room up to ₹2,500/day or accident treatment.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits; maternity, dental, external aids capped
sub_limits.note: Maternity (optional) capped per Schedule; Outpatient Dental (optional) capped; External Medical Aids (optional) capped; Major Illness Hospitalization Expenses capped at additional Basic SI. Core hospitalisation has no stated disease-wise sub-limits.

deductible.note: No base deductible. Global Health Cover (optional) has USD 100 deductible per claim.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; waived for accidents. Waiting Period Modification Option (optional) can reduce this.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 48 months. Waiting Period Modification Option (optional add-on) may reduce this as per Schedule of Coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, gallbladder, joint replacement, etc.) have 24-month waiting period. Waiting Period Modification Option can reduce this.

maternity.note: Parent and Child Care Cover – Basic or Booster (optional). Covers delivery, termination (up to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime), pre/post-natal OPD. Booster also covers infertility treatment up to 50% of normal delivery SI. 48-month waiting period unless modified by optional Waiting Period Modification Option.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of Basic SI added per claim-free year, up to 50% max. Reduced at same rate on claim. Extended Cumulative Bonus optional add-on can increase the rate/cap as per Schedule.

restoration.display: Not covered (base); Sum Insured Rebound optional
restoration.note: No automatic restoration inbuilt. Sum Insured Rebound (optional, Section B-III-6) adds back claim amount paid (up to Basic SI) for subsequent hospitalisations in same policy year. Not a full unlimited restoration.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation for harvesting covered; donor pre/post-hosp excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transfer, hospital-to-hospital, hospital-to-home. No stated rupee cap in base policy.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit. Medically necessary treatments are covered under general hospitalisation cover but no specific modern treatment clause found.

consumables.note: Non-Medical Expenses Cover (optional, Section B-III-10) covers consumables/non-medical items up to limit in Schedule. Base policy excludes non-medical expenses.

global_cover.note: Global Health Cover (Section B-III-18) is optional. Covers hospitalisation and listed benefits outside India with USD 100 deductible per claim. Claims reimbursed in INR.

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, no claim can be contested except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment. No coverage during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability.

notable_exclusions: OPD treatment, stem cell harvesting, external congenital anomalies, sleep apnoea investigation, circumcision (unless medically necessary), hearing aids/spectacles (base), non-allopathic except AYUSH inpatient
optional_riders: Sum Insured Rebound, Parent & Child Care (Basic/Booster), Air Ambulance, Major Illness Hospitalisation, Major Illness Benefit, Non-Medical Expenses, Room Rent Modification, Co-Payment, Extended Cumulative Bonus, Global Health Cover, Hospital Cash, E-Opinion, Surrogacy & Oocyte Donor, Waiting Period Modification, Recovery Benefit, Outpatient Dental, External Medical Aids
